name: Ultimate Magic: Meteor
oracle_text:
Ultimate Magic: Meteor deals 7 damage to each creature. If this spell was cast from exile, for each opponent, choose an artifact or land that player controls. Destroy the chosen permanents.
Foretell {5}{R} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
blocked_sentences: If this spell was cast from exile, for each opponent, choose an artifact or land that player controls. Destroy the chosen permanents.

needs.what: a condition `cast_from_exile` (sibling of `cast_from_graveyard` / `cast_from_hand`) that reads a stamp written by stack.push_spell when the resolving spell was cast out of exile -- foretold, plotted, adventure, or any exile play permission

The rest of the card (damage 7 to each creature, for_each_player opponents + choose_permanents artifact-or-land + destroy, card-level `foretell`) is expressible
